name: &9Professor Quennell
title: &e&lTROPHY FROGS
lines: Welcome to the Atoll! Every frog on this island is a research subject.
Bring me Trophy Frogs - any species, any quality - and I'll log them.
Fill the ledger and you'll earn a collector's title. Duplicates I pay for in Lotus.

name: &aBotanist Brisa
lines: Common Frogs turn up on any cast here. Patience is the whole trick.
When the rain rolls in, the Wetlands Frogs come up to sing. Fish in the rain!

name: &aScribe Pellam
lines: Leap Frogs only bite while you're in the air. Jump as you reel in.
The Puddle Jumper? It bites for people who fly. Or ask the lagoon's legendary creatures nicely.

name: &aAquarist Juniper
lines: Sea Frogs live under the surface - fish with your head under water.
Stand among a raft of lily pads and you might catch an Exploding Frog. Stand back!

name: &aScout Marisol
lines: There are holes in the air over this island. You can't see them without Frog Goggles.
Wear any pair and a Reality Hopper might hop out of one onto your line.

name: &aSurveyor Peregrin
lines: Up here on the Highlands the frogs are tougher. Highlands Frogs bite only on the crown.
Hobb's launch pad by the lagoon gets you up in a hurry.

name: &aRanger Tobiah
lines: Cave Frogs only live in the Lotus Eater's Cave, right behind me.
Throw a Frogcoin in the cave pool. While its blessing lasts, Blessed Frogs bite.

name: &aCurator Wrenna
lines: Tree Frogs bite for anglers standing in the leaves. Climb a canopy and cast.
And the Bullfrogs? They only respect someone in a red sweater. Don't ask me why.

name: &2The Lotus Eater
lines: ...Ribbit.
Four coins in the water and I wake. Bring me a Diamond Lotus and I'll trade.

name: &bThe Wishing Waters
title: &e&lTOSS A FROGCOIN
lines: The pool glitters. Something below is watching the coins fall.

name: &eLauncher Hobb
title: &e&lTO THE HIGHLANDS
lines: Hop on the pad, hold your hat, and I'll send you up to the Highlands!

name: &fBait-seller Corvina
title: &e&lSHOP
lines: Rods, pads, odds and ends for a day on the water.

name: &fCaptain Marlowe
title: &e&lSHIP
lines: Ready to head back? The ship's waiting at the pier.

name: &6Wayfinder Calla
title: &e&lCANYON JOURNAL
lines: You made it down the Marsh road! This canyon still has most of its secrets.
I keep a journal of everything we learn. Help me fill it and I'll make it worth your while.

name: &dSteward Odalys
title: &e&lSTARFALL CONTEST
lines: Every twenty minutes the canyon runs a Starfall Contest: fell spiral trees, pick veilshrooms.
Your points and bracket are in your foraging journal.

name: &aClerk Ottavia
title: &e&lSAFARI OFFICE
lines: The Critter Safari keeps its records here. Tickets come from the Starfall Contests.
Hunters of Hunting XV and up may book a trip at the gate on the Heights.

name: &6The Ant Overseer
title: &e&lSHOP
lines: Click-click. The colony carves minion stones, for coin and a mountain of logs.
Mind the Queen. She doesn't like visitors.

name: &eBeekeeper Hollin
lines: These hives feed half the canyon. The bees don't mind you if you don't mind them.
The Grizzly to the west minds them very much, mind you.

name: &aHunter Brannoch
lines: The Heights are crawling with critters, and every one of them carries a shard.
A Grizzly Bear prowls the west woods. Bring friends.

name: &aForager Bramwyn
lines: Spiral trees! Pale bark first, then the red heartwood. Cut them out of order and you'll regret it.
They're tougher than anything in the Moonmarsh. Bring a proper axe.

name: &bDiver Morwen
lines: The springs go down a long way. The Shallows are friendly; the Depths are not.
Fish here and stranger things bite than anywhere on the Marsh.

name: &aReceptionist Jutta
title: &e&lCRITTER SAFARI
lines: Welcome to the Critter Safari! Hunting XV and a Safari Ticket, please.
